title: A Novel Heterometallic 3d–f Complex with an Unusual [MnIV4Nd4O4] Core Topology

material_class.structural_family: [MnIV4NdIII4O4] core with two distorted [Nd2Mn2(μ4-O)] tetrahedral units linked by μ3-O ligands

synthesis.procedure: MnCl2·4H2O (189 mg, 1 mmol, 1 equiv.), Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (878 mg, 2 mmol, 2 equiv.), 2′-hydroxyacetophenoxime (Me-saoH2; 151 mg, 1 mmol, 1 equiv.) and NEt4OH (25% in methanol; 2 mL, 3 mmol, 3 equiv.) were combined in methanol (60 mL). After stirring for 12 h, the solution was concentrated to ca. 45 mL, filtered, concentrated again to ca. 20 mL and layered with diethyl ether (20 mL). A few black crystals of 1 formed within about one month. No inert-gas techniques were applied; HPLC-grade methanol was used. Isolated yield of pure 1 is only about 5%.
synthesis.time: stirred 12 h; crystals formed within about one month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction in methanol followed by concentration, filtration, and diethyl-ether layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: concentrated to ca. 45 mL, filtered, concentrated to ca. 20 mL, layered with 20 mL diethyl ether; black crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction
